derived_from: behavior_c5.json (same acceptance criteria, phrased as WebVoyager checklist items)

000022.task: Create a new call log via the New Call form with required fields filled.
000022.expected_result: A confirmation message appears, and the new call log displays a human-readable ID with the CALL- prefix (e.g. CALL-001) and a 'Last updated' timestamp. The call appears in the Open Calls or To-Do Calls view.

000022.task: Modify an existing client's information (or close/mark done an existing call).
000022.expected_result: A confirmation message appears and the record's 'Last updated' timestamp refreshes to reflect the change.

000023.task: Create a new lead via the New Lead form/modal with valid details.
000023.expected_result: A confirmation message appears, and the new lead is shown with a LEAD- prefixed ID (e.g. LEAD-001) and a 'Last updated' timestamp or date, visible in the leads table.

000023.task: Change that lead's status (or edit it), then locate it using the leads search or filters.
000023.expected_result: A confirmation appears, the 'Last updated' value refreshes, and the lead is findable via search/filter with its LEAD- ID still displayed.

000044.task: Register a new product via the registration form.
000044.expected_result: A confirmation message appears and the product's SCT- prefixed ID is displayed immediately upon registration.

000044.task: Add a checkpoint to that product on the Track screen, then look it up on the Inquiry screen.
000044.expected_result: A confirmation appears for the checkpoint, the product's 'Last updated' line refreshes, and the product is findable via the Inquiry search with its updated status.

000046.task: Create a new patient electronic file in the patient management section.
000046.expected_result: A confirmation message appears and the new patient record displays a PAT- prefixed ID (e.g. PAT-001) and a 'Last updated' timestamp or date, visible in the patient files list.

000046.task: Add a new medicine in the pharmacy section (or collect a patient fee in finances).
000046.expected_result: A confirmation appears and the new record shows its prefixed ID (MED- or FEE-) with a 'Last updated' value, findable in the corresponding section list.

000080.task: Add a new task via the Add Task input.
000080.expected_result: A confirmation message appears and the new task row displays a TASK- prefixed ID (e.g. TASK-001) and a 'Last updated' timestamp or date.

000080.task: Edit that task's description (or toggle it complete), then find it via search and the matching filter.
000080.expected_result: A confirmation appears, the 'Last updated' value refreshes, the ID persists, and the task is findable via search and under the correct All/Active/Completed filter.

000083.task: Submit a real-time report on a case.
000083.expected_result: A confirmation message appears and the new report entry displays an RPT- prefixed ID with a timestamp, visible in the selected case's report history.

000083.task: Log work hours for the same case.
000083.expected_result: A confirmation appears, the new hours entry shows an HRS- prefixed ID with a 'Last updated' timestamp, and the case's total hours update.

000085.task: Create a new project via the New Project action.
000085.expected_result: A confirmation message appears and the new project row displays a PRJ- prefixed ID (e.g. PRJ-001) and a 'Last updated' date, visible in the Projects table and reflected on the dashboard.

000085.task: Add a schedule task (or a document), then mark the task complete.
000085.expected_result: A confirmation appears on create, the record shows its prefixed ID (TASK- or DOC-) with a 'Last updated' value that refreshes on the completion toggle.
